import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../lib/api';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import NoteForm from '../components/NoteForm';
import NoteList from '../components/NoteList';
import EmptyState from '../components/EmptyState';

export default function NotesPage() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    api
      .get('/api/notes')
      .then((res) => {
        if (active) setNotes(res.data ?? []);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (active) setError(err?.response?.data?.detail ?? 'Failed to load notes');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleDeleteNote = (id) => {
    api
      .delete(`/api/notes/${id}`)
      .then(() => {
        setNotes(notes.filter((note) => note.id !== id));
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
      });
  };

  const handleCreateNote = (note) => {
    api
      .post('/api/notes', note)
      .then((res) => {
        setNotes([...notes, res.data]);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
      });
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="p-6 text-center text-gray-500">Loading notes…</div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="p-6 text-center text-red-600">{error}</div>;
  }

  if (notes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-screen">
        <EmptyState message="No notes yet." />
        <NoteForm onCreate={handleCreateNote} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen">
      <Header noteCount={notes.length} />
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6">
        <NoteForm onCreate={handleCreateNote} />
        <NoteList notes={notes} onDelete={handleDeleteNote} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
